_comment: Labelled network cameras for the Meta Trio camera rail.
These are real NYCTMC (NYC DOT) traffic cameras: each `input` is the camera
vendor's own JPEG endpoint (Axis Q60xx/Q56xx units, per the EXIF the
upstream sends), fetched through the ffmpeg snapshot proxy in ipcam.mjs so
every page gets the same contract - a name, a position, and an image URL.
No credentials are stored here and none are needed; the public endpoints
are unauthenticated. Verified live with curl: six HTTP 200 image/jpeg
One camera per borough plus a second Manhattan feed, so the rail reads as a
city and not as one grid. `id` is what appears in /api/ipcam/<id>/snapshot,
so it is a slug, not the vendor UUID; rename one and the URL changes.
If a camera is offline the proxy answers 502 with the upstream reason and
the page keeps the tile with its label - a missing feed must never blank
